verdict.rationale: Pika's own docs claim a clip-extension tool that makes any clip longer by generating extra frames, which covers the 'extend a clip' half of the story. The evidence is only a one-line marketing claim, and nothing documents regenerating a specific time segment of a clip. Swap Anything, Add Elements and Pikadditions alter objects in a shot rather than re-generating a segment, and Trim only cuts length, so none of them is credited. Missing for 10: documented regeneration of a chosen segment, detail on extension controls (length, continuity, no full re-render), independent or hands-on corroboration.
